note: Riverside resort on 65 acres by the Suwannee River at Mayo, with lodging from cabins to lodge rooms and two RV areas: Primrose Park for families and Key West Village for adults 21 and over.  Some sites are fenced for pets, and there are heated pools and hot tubs (open all year), dog parks and a pet wash.  Lower Rendezvous, a separate area, has the tent and small-RV sites, without cable.  Long-term stays are in the Key West section. --Claude
